text: give the uv mapping a very definite grid for snapping or i know what it might be, it might be the fact that there is absolute 0 ability to group parts together in a chain or get them all the same size or any of that which is a pain in the ass. also, you gonna want to make it so this whole side panel can drag to resize this is still just insanely small area to work in
resolution: The UV workspace now exposes a strong minor/major grid whose visible interval is the exact effective translation snap, with explicit 1/2/4/8/16-texel precision controls and Alt free movement. Shift-click builds a temporary multi-island set that drags rigidly, preserves member offsets at atlas bounds, can match the active island's width/height/full size, and can form horizontal or vertical grid-aligned chains. The Paint/UV focus panel now has a full-height pointer-captured left-edge resize grip with separate remembered normal/focus widths, frame-coalesced updates, and bounded stage retention. Verified by 24 UV layout tests, UV workspace policy tests, editor TypeScript check, and a ReleaseFast editor ship build.
